# CRM Deployment & Integration

| Deployment concern | Practical requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Tenant and identity | Separate customer tenants, define role-based access and reclaim ownership when a salesperson leaves. |
| Master data | Establish canonical identifiers for accounts, contacts, products, price lists, orders and payments before synchronisation. |
| Connector scope | Confirm target ERP, finance, marketing, email, messaging and order interfaces; do not infer integration from a product label alone. |
| Regional operation | Support time zones, languages, currencies, data residency and country-specific outreach controls where required. |
| Change management | Start with one sales workflow and measurable POC outcomes, then expand connectors and automation after reconciliation is stable. |
| Audit and recovery | Keep operation logs, approval history, data-export records and a rollback path for high-risk AI writes. |
